metadata.chunk_title: Requirements - Employer

programme_facts.value: The employer that signs the Form I-983 must be the same entity that provides the practical training experience to the student.

metadata.chunk_title: Requirements - Employer

programme_facts.value: The employer may not be the F-1 student’s employer in name only and may not assign, or otherwise delegate its training responsibilities to a non-employer third party (for example, a client or customer of the employer).

metadata.chunk_title: Requirements - Employer

programme_facts.value: Employer must report any material changes of the F-1 student’s employment by filling out a modified Form I-983.

metadata.chunk_title: Requirements - Employer

programme_facts.value: If applicable, the employer must report the F-1 student’s termination of employment or departure to the Designated School Official (DSO) within 5 business days.

metadata.chunk_title: Requirements - Employer

programme_facts.value: F-1 students seeking STEM OPT extensions may be employed by new start-up businesses so long as all regulatory requirements listed above are met.
